q1_issues.issue: (Cardinality sk_classes_1 48) says the group contains 48 classes, but "classes of 48" states the size of each individual class, not how many classes there are.
(Member sk_classes_1 full) predicates "full" of the group-as-object, which Categorical statements explicitly forbids for a members' property — it must distribute over the members or ride the kind.
The kind word in the text is "Administration"; typing the TSA as agency substitutes a world-knowledge synonym no word in the sentence puts there.
"its classes" is a possessed plural but no (Possession …) link to the TSA is emitted, and it silently reuses the same group symbol as the "full classes of 48".
(GroupOf sk_classes_1 class) is projected to top level although "full classes" is indefinite and introduced inside the sealed report — only definite referents project out of a seal.
(Patient sk_book_1 sk_classes_1): booking neither creates, destroys, consumes nor changes the classes, so the direct-object test gives Theme.

q2_gaps: a size postmodifier distributing over a plural ("classes of 48", "teams of five"): Cardinality rides one group, so there is no licensed way to state each member-group's own size
mid-sentence quotative parenthetical ("…, he said, and <second clause>"): nothing says how far the reported-speech seal extends over a following coordinated clause
notes: The attitude scaffolding is right — say with Experiencer, non-factive seal under Theme, unanchored "he" as sk_person_1, plan-to-double handled as a control verb with the controller copied in and no tense on the complement. The defects are concentrated inside the sealed (And …) term.
